intro.title: CollegeTour Project Overview
intro.desc: This is a team collaboration project. I mainly handled backend modules, specifically the SQLite-based DataManager and administrator login verification pipeline.

summary.text: This page only presents code snippets. No video section is included by design. The selected files focus on backend data lifecycle and administrator verification logic.

data_manager_class.desc: DataManager class contract, members, and backend-facing interfaces.

data_manager_init.desc: Initializes core data structures and startup loading path.

data_manager_read_dynamic.desc: Reads runtime data from SQLite-backed storage and maps it into in-memory state.

data_manager_reset_database.desc: Resets backend data state and rebuilds required base records.

login_xor.desc: Administrator login verification flow and XOR-based credential processing.
